label: Lasso select
intent: A lasso is drawn around the object and the object is selected. Light: the loop is drawn freehand from where the tail joins it, up the right side, over the top and back round the bottom, closing on itself; the object inside pops once as it is caught. Strong: the tail is drawn in first, the loop sweeps round faster and closes hard, then it cinches tight around the object and springs back while the object pops and settles in two beats.

tail.//: v1's tail, written from its free end so it draws in toward the loop

loop.//: v1's loop, the same curve restarted where the tail joins it (its first segment split at t 0.5) and run the other way, so the drawing starts at the tail

lasso.//: the cinch: the rope tightens about the object
